summary: Sandbach United suffered a tough 3-2 defeat away at Foley Meir in their opening match, with Saul Shotton grabbing a late consolation goal but ultimately unable to prevent a frustrating loss where the team rued missed chances and defensive lapses. The squad will be looking to bounce back this Saturday when they host Stafford Town at home, a promotion contender they'll need to be at their sharpest to face. Manager and fans will be hoping for a much-improved display as the season kicks into gear.
